messages:
Priya S.: FYI we have a paying customer hitting 401s when calling /v1/chat/completions. They say the same key worked earlier today. Error body: `{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key.","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"invalid_api_key"}}`. Ticket attached with curl they used.

Jun Park: Can you paste their curl? common issues are wrong header name or accidental trailing whitespace when copying from the portal. Also check whether they are using `Authorization: Bearer` vs `Api-Key:`.

Priya S.: Here's what customer sent (redacted key replaced with <REDACTED>):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'
```
They said they copy/pasted from a Mac Notes app. They also tried with our SDK and got same 401.

Support Bot: Automated check: that API key (id: key_abc123) was last seen 2 hours ago and shows status=active in the control plane. No recent rotations. No policy blocks.

Jun Park: Ok, that rules out immediate revocation. Two possibilities: 1) The customer copy included an extra newline/whitespace character, or 2) their client library is URL-encoding the header or sending `Authorization` header incorrectly. Ask them to run a raw curl with `-v` and paste the request headers. Also have them run `xxd -g 1 -c 200` on the file containing the key to check for hidden chars.

Priya S.: Sent back instructions. Customer replied with verbose curl output. They had `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` (CR present) — looks like Windows line endings sneaking in via some editor, then their reverse proxy was dropping the header. They claim direct curl from their machine (without the proxy) still 401s though.

Michael L.: If the header has a trailing `` that could cause the token to be treated as invalid. But Support Bot shows the key active. Let's rule out scope: is the key limited to embeddings-only? I see in the account that key_abc123 is scoped to chat+generate.

Jun Park: Another quick repro — curl locally with the exact header string reported: `-H $'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'` returns 401 for me. Without the `` it works. So hidden CR is enough to break auth.

Priya S.: Customer ran `tr -d '\r'` on the token file and then retested — success. They asked if we can make error message clearer for this case. Right now it's a generic invalid_api_key.

Ops Oncall: Good catch. This is a common UX bug. Suggestion: Add a diagnostic hint in the auth failure logs that detects ASCII control chars or trailing whitespace in the presented token and include structured telemetry (but not the token) to indicate whitespace trimmed vs exact mismatch. Also add a KB article for "API key returns 401" with step to `xxd`/`hexdump` and how to re-copy from portal using the copy button.

Michael L.: I'll open an infra ticket to add a heuristic that if the only difference between stored key and presented key is whitespace/control chars, return a 401 with `hint: invalid_api_key_whitespace` in the internal logs and surface a friendly user message in the dashboard.

Priya S.: Customer is unblocked after trimming CR. They've accepted a small credit. I've added the KB link and steps to the ticket. Closing once infra backlog item is created. :white_check_mark:
